verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a user-definable rules or event-trigger system that automatically runs actions on events. The Machine restart policy and Sprites that wake on demand are narrow, fixed platform behaviors rather than general event-to-action rules, so they are adjacent controls and earn no credit. A community comment also notes the platform lacks built-in scheduled tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
